title: Canonical biduality for the localization of a locally strictly perfect complex.
statement: For a small ringed site (C,J,R) with independent universes and the sheafification hypotheses of [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package], let K be a cochain complex of R-module sheaves satisfying the local bounded finite-free-retract condition [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package]. For any normalized closed presentation M [lem-sfb-ringed-site-duality-maps], the canonical signed bidual morphism of QK is invertible.

proof.text: Use canonical evaluation invertibility for QK for every N. In the closed monoidal category set V=RHom(QK,O), and define coevaluation as the transpose of the left unitor followed by the inverse evaluation component at QK. The defining equation transposes to the first triangle identity.

Let g be the second triangle endomorphism of V. Monoidal coherence and interchange slide its evaluation to the first triangle, so (g tensor id) followed by evaluation equals evaluation. Transpose this equality. The transpose of evaluation is the left unitor inverse followed by the evaluation component at the tensor unit, an isomorphism. Cancel it to obtain g=id. These two proved triangle identities define an exact pairing QK,V with exactly the specified evaluation.

Swap the exact pairing by Mathlib BraidedCategory.exactPairing_swap. For each A use tensorRightHomEquiv to identify Hom(A,QK) with Hom(A tensor V,O), and the closed adjunction to identify Hom(A,RHom(V,O)) with the same set. The swapped evaluation is braiding followed by the original evaluation, so the defining transpose of ringedSiteBidual identifies its Yoneda map with the composite of these equivalences. Mathlib isIso_of_yoneda_map_bijective proves invertibility.

proof_origin.place: Tag 08JJ, dualizability reformulation: derive canonical biduality from the canonical evaluation comparison by the explicit exact-pairing construction and Mathlib rigid-category Hom equivalences. All categorical glue is proved in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedSitePerfectBidual_model
    {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    [∀ U : C, HasSheafify (J.over U) AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    [∀ U : C, (J.over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{max c v r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R))]
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (hK : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyStrictPerfectComplexOfUniverses.{c, v, r} R K)
    (M : RingedSiteDualityModel.{c, v, r, w} J R)
    : IsIso (ringedSiteBidual M.closed M.symmetric
      (ringedSiteDualityUnit.{c, v, r, w} J R) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K))
